purpose: Add bounded public-catalog packaging price evidence for the Europe-facing sourcing layer. These are source-stated catalog benchmarks, not negotiated production quotes or landed costs.
semantic_boundary: All prices and product facts are source-stated public catalog evidence observed on 2026-08-30.
Prices marked excl. VAT must remain excl. VAT; do not convert or gross-up unless separately authorized.
Do not infer branding cost, shipping, landed cost, stock permanence, material certification or final suitability.
Stage first. Promote to canonical packaging_supplier_offer only when an existing packaging_option is an exact, conflict-free identity match; otherwise leave review_required.
This input does not select a final packaging style.
